'''swcironecg Hidden Base (HB)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[swcironecg]]
* '''Published:''' 10 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor HB swcironecg LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Hidden Base with matching pilots and scouts.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

This is a very simple deck. Using the objective and Insurrection, pull all your locations. Use Rendezvous Point to deploy starships for cheep, then move them for free to Endor. Use scouts to control the docking bay so that you have a battleground site for Menace Fades, to slow down opponent’s drains, and Strikeforce, to protect your own drains. Also, if you occupy Endor, I’ll Take The Leader will add 1 to your force drain at the docking bay. Your goal is to cancel out as much of your opponent’s drains as you can with the objective and Menace Fades while protecting your own drains with Strikeforce. Please rate this deck and tell me what you think, and thanks for reading.
